groups.activity: run the bounty tied to the part you're missing
conditions: The three bounties unlock in sequence: clearing one opens the next.
Each completed bounty pays one Tier A (Fergolyte), one Tier B (2.5% part, 5% SP) and one Tier C (10% part, blueprint 5%, 8% SP) reward.
Fergolyte and mushrooms ignore every booster, drop-chance mod and Retriever/Vacuum-style pet.
bonuses: Hitting every stage bonus objective nearly doubles mushroom income, from ~4 a run to ~9-10.
A Steel Path variant rotates every 2.5 hours for better rates, but it's only one bounty at a time; target the part you need on normal and take SP only when the rotation lines up.

disclosures.title: run the right bounty
disclosures.body: Running whatever's convenient instead of the bounty that drops your missing part is the single biggest time-waster, and it's why some mushrooms feel falsely rare. Volt (range/strength) and Zenith (shoots through walls to find hidden objectives) are the named frames for clearing these fast.

conditions: Rank 4 (Gardener) comes from fully analyzing 12 mushroom species in the Field Guide, not from standing; each species takes 3 analyses (18-30 samples total).
Sample purchases are rank-gated: you can't buy straight to Rank 4, and some species (e.g. Reeking Puffball) only unlock at Rank 5.
bonuses: Composting a duplicate mushroom pays 1 Fergolyte once its species is fully analyzed; buying scarce samples at 10 Fergolyte each is the efficient way to reach Rank 4 without target-farming one species.

disclosures.title: the pity math
disclosures.body: You will almost certainly exhaust the drop-table route before Rank 4 opens, so treat Fergolyte as a slow safety net, not a fast track. The same currency also buys Archgun Arcane Adapters and several arcanes; spend on Nokko parts last.
